div.head: VII Atr 1
div.ab: Inprimis ut unus Deus super omnia diligatur et honoretur, et ut omnes regi suo pareant, sicut antecessores sui melius fecerunt, et cum eo pariter defendant regnum suum.
Inprimis, ut unus Deus super omnia diligatur et honoretur, et ut omnes regi suo pareant, sicut antecessores sui melius fecerunt, et cum eo pariter defendant regnum suum.
Inprimis ut unus Deus super omnia diligatur et honoretur, et ut omnes regi suo pareant, sicut antecessores sui melius fecerunt, et cum eo pariter defendant regnum suum.
Erstens, dass man Einen Gott über alles liebe und ehre, und dass alle ihrem Könige gehorchen, so wie ihre Vorgänger bestens gethan haben, und mit ihm gemeinsam sein Reich vertheidigen.
First, that one God be loved and honoured above all, and that all obey their king, as their predecessors best did, and defend his kingdom together with him.

In the first place, one God shall be loved and honoured above all, and all men shall show obedience to their king in accordance with the best traditions of their ancestors, and co-operate with him in defending his kingdom.
First, that the one God is to be praised and honored above all, and that all should obey their king according to the best customs of their ancestors, and together with him defend his kingdom.
